next.reason: 1985 refuses a VALUE clause in any entry that includes or is subordinate to an EXTERNAL entry (condition-names excepted). 2023 has no such prohibition (§2023:13.18.22.3 lists none) and regulates it instead: §2023:13.18.22.4 GR6 'the VALUE clause specification, if any, for each record name ... shall be identical' across source elements; §2023:13.18.63.4 GR4 a) VALUE takes effect 'for external items, during the execution of an INITIALIZE statement'; §2023:13.18.63.4 GR2 likewise for file-section (external FD) records. Refusal became acceptance with INITIALIZE-only effect; 88-level VALUE still allowed.
